description: Production model selection for CargoMind ML inference (cargomind_ml.inference). Product decision; the ML stage's own metric-based picks are in ML/ML/results/comparison/selection.json and are unchanged.

classifier.name: xgboost
classifier.decision_rule: argmax of the three class probabilities (raw; calibration not justified on validation, see ML/Evaluation/calibration_study/decision.json)
classifier.status: provisional primary (2026-11-02): not shown to be statistically better than Logistic Regression on the synthetic data
classifier.alert_threshold_note: No P(Critical) alert threshold is set. Choosing one requires an explicit decision on the cost of a missed Critical shipment versus a false Critical alert.

anomaly_detector.name: isolation_forest
anomaly_detector.role: primary anomaly detector (unusual origin operating state); separate output, never combined with the classifier
anomaly_detector.flag_rule: anomaly_score > threshold stored in the bundle (95th percentile of training On-Time scores)

evidence: ML/Evaluation/reports/evaluation_report.md: XGBoost and Logistic Regression are statistically indistinguishable on test macro-F1 (LR - XGB +0.011, 95% CI -0.013..+0.042); XGBoost is not claimed to be better. Isolation Forest is the better detector (delayed ROC-AUC +0.024, CI excludes 0).
